newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Tadiran Telecom gets China Unicom deal.
newsitem.headline: Tadiran Telecom gets China Unicom deal.

text.p: Tadiran Telecommunications Ltd on Wednesday said it had signed a framework agreement with a subsidiary of China United Telecommunications Corp (China Unicom) for the supply of wireline and wireless access systems.
The one-year contract with Beijing Lian Tong Ren Economic Trade Co for the supply of systems and services to China Unicom is worth $10 million. The contract has an extension option.
The first system will be installed in mid-1997.

"Representing an expanding involvement of Tadiran Telecom in the telecom market of China, the agreement will no doubt lead to continued cooperation and positive results," Haim Rosen, president and CEO of the Israeli company, said in a statement.
China Unicom is the second telecom operator in China.
Tadiran Telecom is a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd .
